name: execute-write-command
description:
Execute a write CLI command (create, update, delete, add, remove). Use discover-commands with category='write' first.

Note: Do not include --json in argv; JSON output is automatic.

Common operations:
- Create entities: person create, company create, opportunity create
- Add to lists: entry add "<list>" --person-id <id> (or --company-id)
- Log interactions: interaction create --type meeting --person-id <id>
- Update list entry fields: entry field "<list>" <entryId> --set <field> <value>

Examples:
- person create --first-name John --last-name Doe --emails john@example.com
- interaction create --type meeting --direction outgoing --person-id 123
- note create --person-id 456 --content 'Meeting notes here'
- entry field "Dealflow" 123 --set Status "Active"

Commands that cannot be undone (delete, merge) need the user's explicit confirmation: call without confirm first; the server refuses with confirmation_required (or shows the user a dialog). Then ask the user in the conversation, and only after they explicitly agree to that exact action, call again with confirm=true. Never set confirm on your own; a confirm=true the server did not ask for is not used.

command.description: CLI command path (e.g., 'person create', 'list-entry add', 'interaction create'). Use discover-commands with category='write' to find available commands.

argv.description: Command arguments as array. Use '--flag', 'value' pairs. Example: ['--first-name', 'John', '--last-name', 'Doe', '--emails', 'john@example.com']

confirm.description: For commands that cannot be undone (delete, merge): set to true only on the second call, after the server answered confirmation_required and the user explicitly confirmed this exact action in the conversation. Ignored if the server did not ask first. Appends --yes to the CLI call.

dryRun.description: If true, return the command that would be executed without running it. Use to verify command before execution.

timeoutHint: For batch creates, reduce batch size. Check network connectivity if retries exhaust.
